corinthians1.16.p1.b1.text: Now about the collection for the saints, you are to do as I directed the churches of Galatia:

corinthians1.16.p1.b2.text: On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.

corinthians1.16.p1.b3.text: Then, on my arrival, I will send letters with those you recommend to carry your gift to Jerusalem.

corinthians1.16.p2.b1.text: After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; … Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, …

corinthians1.16.p2.b2.text: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,

corinthians1.16.p2.b3.text: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me.

corinthians1.16.p3.b1.text: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.

corinthians1.16.p3.b2.text: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. …

corinthians1.16.p3.b3.text: … He was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.

corinthians1.16.p4.b1.text: Be on the alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be men of courage. Be strong.

corinthians1.16.p5.b1.text: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. …

corinthians1.16.p5.b2.text: I am glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.

corinthians1.16.p6.b1.text: … Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.

corinthians1.16.p6.b2.text: All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

corinthians1.16.p6.b3.text: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul.

corinthians1.16.p7.b2.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.

corinthians1.16.p7.b3.text: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
